tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i gdon sgrol gyi cho ga bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ gdengs can rnams kyi spyi bo'i khrir bzhugs nas// sa dang steng gi gdon kun 'jigs mdzad pa// snying rje'i dbang phyug 'phags pa seng ge sgra// drang srong chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon byas rnam smin nad gdon mi bzad thob// de sel sman gyi dbang po 'di yin zhes// rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin rje btsun mai tri pas// dril bsgrags de ka lag tu len tshul 'di'o// 'dir 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i gzungs chog slob dpon chen po mai tri pa'i man ngag ji ltar lag len du bdar bar 'dod pas/ bsnyen pa/ bsgrub pa/ las sbyor gsum las/ dang po ni/ dge slong ngam/ dge tshul lam/ khyim pa zhig na bsnyen gnas la gnas te/ bdag nyid stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ skad cig gis snying gar oṃ la zla ba/ de'i steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de'i 'od zer gyis khams gsum snang bar byas te 'og min du song*/ bcom ldan 'das seng ge sgra 'khor bzhi bla ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yid kyis spyan drangs la/ spyan sngar/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gus pas dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don gnyis rab sgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog lan gsum gyis sems bskyed blangs te tshogs zhing rang gnas su gshegs/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ bdag med pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma 'dab bzhi ze'u 'brur oṃ las zla ba/ a dkar po las seng ge dkar mo'i steng du paṃ las pad dkar ze'u 'brur hrīḥdakar po rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun seng ge sgra zla shel gyi mdangs can phyag g.yon sar btsugs shing g.yas pa chos 'chad/ dka' thub pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa/ stag sham can/ rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i g.yas na sbrul dkar pos dkris pa'i rtse gsum dkar po/ g.yon na pad+ma langs pa'i steng na 'bar ba'i ral gri 'phyar ba'i mdun du me tog gis gang ba'i thod pa dkar po/ 'od zer gyi sprin gyi rtser sangs rgyas lnga rnam par 'phro ba g.yas su sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob ljang sngon phyed dkyil gyis bzhugs pa/ rgyab tu yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo dkar mo spyan bdun skyil krung gis bzhugs pa gnyis phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pal sngon po dang dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du rta mgrin rtsa zhal khro zhing steng rta zhal ljang zhur rta skad drag po sgrog pa g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas dbyug tho/ g.yon thugs kar sdig mdzub/ mdun du chu bdag ba ru ṇa dkar po stod lha'i gzugs la sbrul gyi gdeng ka dgu /smad sbrul mjug phyag thal mo sbyar ba'o// gtso bo'i thugs kar oṃ las zla ba/ de'i steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de'i 'od zer gyis khams gsum snang bar byas te 'og min du song*/ bcom ldan 'das seng ge sgra 'khor bzhi dbang lha rigs lnga dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

thugs rjes sems can kun la bye brag med par thugs rjer mdzad pa yi// 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug khyod mchod chu bos yid ni dag byed de// 'bad pa don yod gcig pur mthong nas blta bar re ba bcas gyur pa// sdig 'joms dam bca' bdag la 'bras ldan mdzad du deng 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ rigs lngas rin po che'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las ral pa'i zur phud la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang*// mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab bkye ste// mchod yon sna tshogs rab tu bkram byas nas// bdag nyid chen po 'khor bcas mchod par bgyi// oṃ lo ke shwa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du rigs bsgres nas / me tog puṣ+pe/ bdug spos/ dhū pe/ mar me/ ā lo ke dri chab/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas/ nai wi d+ye/ rol mo/ shap+ta/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar// spyan gsum seng ge la gnas shing*// nad kun 'joms byed bla ma ni// seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar bsgoms pas dub na bzlas pa bya ste// snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar/ oṃ ā hrīḥsidha nā da hūṃ phaṭ swāhā/ zhes bzla dmigs pa ni/ snying gar rdo rje'i gdan la mi bskyod pa de'i thugs kar sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa 'od zer du 'bar bas rang gi lus gang*/ de nas 'od zer gyi sna la sangs rgyas lnga bzhugs pa dpag tu med pas phyir song 'jig rten gyi khams gang*/ des steng 'og bar gyi gdon thams cad btul nas sems can thams cad bde ba la bkod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bsdus/ bdag nyid kyi lus ngag yid la thim pas nus pa dang ldan par bsam mo// phan yon/ rig sngags kyi snying po 'di lan cig brjod pas sdig pa kun las grol bar 'gyur ro// srid pa nyam ngar 'gro mi 'gyur// lus la mtshon gyis tshugs mi 'gyur// dgra dang chom pos mi tshugs shing*// klu la sogs pas 'tshe mi 'gyur// rtag tu dpal dang ldan par 'gyur// bud med lus su mi 'gyur zhing*// rtag tu skye ba dran par 'gyur// shi nas bde ba can du 'gro/

zhes gsungs so// gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya lo ke te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a ka ṭe bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe ka ro ṭe ka ro ṭe bir ye swā hā/ 'di gzungs so// de'i cho ga ni/ oṃ re khe hū ཾ zhes pas/ bris sku la sogs pa gang du bkram pa'i phyogs de/ ri bo po ta la'i rtse mo na rin po che'i khang bzang rin po che dang*/ mu tig dang*/ nor bu dpag med kyis spras pa/ 'od kyis stong gsum khyab pa/ me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs kyis kun nas brgyan pa'i nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma 'dab bzhi ze'u 'brur oṃ las zla ba/ a dkar po las seng ge dkar mo'i steng du paṃ las pad dkar ze'u 'brur hrīḥdakar po rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rje btsun seng ge sgra zla shel gyi mdangs can phyag g.yon sar btsugs shing g.yas pa chos 'chad/ dka' thub pa'i cha lugs 'dzin pa/ stag sham can/ rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i g.yas na sbrul dkar pos dkris pa'i rtse gsum dkar po/ g.yon na pad+ma langs pa'i steng na 'bar ba'i ral gri 'phyar ba'i mdun du me tog gis gang ba'i thod pa dkar po/ 'od zer gyi sprin gyi rtser sangs rgyas lnga rnam par 'phro ba g.yas su sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob ljang sngon phyed dkyil gyis bzhugs pa/ rgyab tu yid bzhin gyi 'khor lo dkar mo spyan bdun skyil krung gis bzhugs pa gnyis phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pal sngon po dang dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du rta mgrin rtsa zhal khro zhing steng rta zhal ljang zhur rta skad drag po sgrog pa g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ g.yas dbyug tho/ g.yon thugs kar sdig mdzub/ mdun du chu bdag ba ru ṇa dkar po stod lha'i gzugs la sbrul gyi gdeng ka dgu /smad sbrul mjug phyag thal mo sbyar ba'o// gtso bo'i thugs kar oṃ las zla ba/

de'i steng du hrīḥdakar po/ de'i 'od zer gyis khams gsum snang bar byas te 'og min du song*/ bcom ldan 'das seng ge sgra 'khor bzhi dbang lha rigs lnga dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ thugs rjes sems can kun la bye brag med par thugs rjer mdzad pa yi// 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug khyod mchod chu bos yid ni dag byed de// 'bad pa don yod gcig pur mthong nas blta bar re ba bcas gyur pa// sdig 'joms dam bca' bdag la 'bras ldan mdzad du deng 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ rigs lngas rin po che'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las ral pa'i zur phud la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de'i spyan sngar/ lci ba sa la ma lhung bas so sor ma 'dres par maṇ+ḍal brgyad byas te/ maṇ+ḍal re re la me tog tshom bu lnga lnga bkram ste/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ spos dang*/ 'phreng ba dang*/ phye ma rnams kyis mchod nas/ gzungs bzhin du bstod pa bya'o// maṇ+ḍal re re la gzungs lan bcu gsum bcu gsum gyi bar du bzlas la lci ba de bsdus te/ lci ba lhag ma la'ang sngags shing nad pa la byugs na nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro// lha dang klu la sogs pa'i dug gi nad thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro// gtor ma oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa snying po'i mthar ba liṃ ta btags pa 'bul/ bdag gis 'jig rten ma lus nyes pa byang gyur legs pa'i lam la ma bkod ji srid pa// yang dag don phyir bdag ni byang chub mchog tu de srid 'gro bar mi bya zhes// gang gis khams gsum 'di dag la ni seng ge'i sgra chen gsal bar bsgrags gyur pa// bcom ldan khyod kyi 'gro don dus babs bdag gis bsam pa thams cad 'grub par mdzod// ces gsol/ las sbyor la/

gdon 'grol dang*/ las sna tshogs gnyis/ dang po/ gdon 'grol bya bar 'dod pas/ dkyil 'khor bca' ba/ lha'i rnal 'byor/ klu la mchod pa/ gdon mchod/ bkru ba dang*/ byab pa/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ shis brjod dgu las/ dang po/ snum pa'i sa la ba dmar po'i lci ba sar ma lhung ba blangs/ des byug pa'i tshon sna lngas dkyil 'khor rgyar 'dom gang*/ dbyibs gzhal yas khang spyi dang mthun khyams chu ris/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa ge sar dang bcas pa lha mtshan bkod/ de'i khar mañdzi/ de'i khar bum pa lnga/ seng ldeng gi phur bu lnga/ mda' dar bzhi bshams/ khyams kyi shar lhor seng ldeng dang rgya shug gi me snod/ dbang ldan du chu snod/ rma bya'i sgro dang*/ gzugs mo byi thur/ me long gsum khong gi dug 'don pa dang*/ sma shad phyir mi bzlog pa'i phyir/ klu'i gzugs sna tshogs chu snod du bkod/ me tog la sogs pa mchod pa/ gdugs rgyal mtshan 'phreng ba/ tshangs skud klu sman/ srog chags yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs gter gyi bum pa rnams klu mchod pa'i rdzas su bkod/ de nas dkyil 'khor der nad pa gzhug tshon skud sna lngas de dang*/ klu gzugs rnams kyi bar dra ba bres/ gnyis pa/ de nas slob dpon bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed bum bzlas bya/ gsum pa/ de tshar ba dang mdun gyi klu gzugs rnams klu'i rgyal po brgyad/ klu/ sa bdag gnyan bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor bar bsam la/ gdeng ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa ma lus sel byed cing*// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ba ru ṇa ā gats+tsha ya ā gats+tsha ya/ ma hā nā ga ki sa ti sarbe bhur phu phu phu swā hā/ zhes spyan drangs/ oṃ bha ga bi ta/ shru tismri sa ma ba ti/ sa ra ma ti sid+dha swā hā/ zhes gnyis su med par bstim/ oṃ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha/ dza hūṃ phaṭ swāhā/

oṃ ad pra ti hūṃ phaṭ/ pri ti ka ra hūṃ phaṭ/ dam bzhag bya/ de nas mchod pa rnams yid kyis klu rnams dgyes pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam nas/ me tog spos dang byug pa dang*// mar me zhal zas sgra snyan dang*// gdugs dang rgyal mtshan me tog 'phreng*// tshangs pa'i skud pas mnyes par bya// rtsa ba lo ma sdong bu dang*// me tog 'bras bu sman gyi tshogs// srog chags yid 'ong gzugs kyis mchod// oṃ āḥhūṃ/ oṃ ba ling+ta bhuñdza dzi ba/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe hūṃ sarba a mṛ te hūṃ/ a pa ta li/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ dza swā hā/ oṃ chen po'ang chung ngu gang dag gis// lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i// nad de nye bar phyung nas su// klu rnams rang gi gnas su dengs// bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// klu rgyal po ba ru ṇa la/ klu rgyal po tak+ṣa kā la/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas la/ klu'i rgyal po pad+ma la/ klu rgyal po pad+ma chen po la/ klu rgyal po dung skyong la/ klu'i rgyal po rigs ldan la/ klu rgyal po dga' bo la/ klu rgyal po nor rgyas la/ oṃ ba ru ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ a nan+tā ya swā hā/ oṃ bā su ka ye swā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā ya swā hā/ oṃ karkoṭā ya swā hā/ oṃ pad+mā ya swā hā/ oṃ pad+ma ma hā ya swā hā/ oṃ shaṅkha pā lā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku li ka ya swā hā/ zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ bzhi pa/ de nas cha gsum gtor ma btang*/ lnga pa/ de nas bum pa lnga'i chu las dum zhig snod gcig tu bsdus/ des seng ge sgra gtso 'khor dang sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la khrus gsol bar mos pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o//

zhes rten la khrus gsol ba'i chu slar bum par bsdus la bsgrub bya bkru ba ni/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma dag byed cing*// gtong ba dri yi legs bsgos chu// khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o// gzungs dang*/ che ge zhes bya ba'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par du yang*/ nyon mongs pa ser sna'i dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig de bzhin du rigs bsgres nas/ 'di ni tshul khrims/ khrims 'chal/ 'di ni bzod pa'i/ khong khro'i sogs/ 'di ni brtson 'grus/ le lo'i sogs/ 'di ni bsam gtan/ rnams g.yeng sogs/ 'di ni shes rab/ shes 'chal sogs/ zhes bum pa'i chus sdig sgrib nag 'dur 'dur/ gdon thams cad sdig pa dang sbal lcong sbrul 'bu sogs srog chags kyi rigs su 'thon nas snod der zhugs par

bsam/ bsgrub bya bkrus pa'i khu ba snod gcig tu bzhag go drug pa/ seng ldeng dang rgya shug gi me thab oṃ a bigh+nān+ta krita hūṃ gis bsangs/ oṃ ag+ne ya a ti bya/ a bhi sa ma ya bi sha/ ma hā shrī ye ha bya/ ka bya ma hā na ye swā hā/ zhes shar lho nas drang srong me lha spyan drangs shing der bzhugs par bsam/ dngos su me spar/ oṃ pā ba ka ag+ne ya/ shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ mar khu phul/ de nas/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hā/ oṃ a ka ṭe bi ka ṭe ni ka ṭe ka ṭaṃ swā hā/ zhes bzlas/ nad pa'i nad gdon thams cad don nas til gyi phung po la thim par bsam zhing*/ de dang tshon skud lnga gris dum bu re bcad/ thams cad lhag med par me lha'i zhal du sngags 'dis 'bul/ oṃ a hrīḥhūṃ swā hā/ phu hrīḥ.oṃ sidha nā da hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ/ nā ga du pa li mā ra ya phaṭ/ dz+wa la dz+wa la hūṃ phaṭ/ ces bsgrub bya'i lo grangs phul/ de nas mda' dar/ rma bya'i sgro/ gzung mo byi thur/ rma shad/ me long rnams kyis byab cing*/ hrīḥnā ga le le/ nā ga dum pa le le/ nā ga phuta phuta ha le ha le/ hā la hā la/ s+phu ṭa s+phu ṭa nā ga khrol khrol shig shig swāhā/ klu dang log 'dren thams cad kyi yid kyi dug dang*/ mthong ba'i dug dang*/ bcing ba'i= kha rlangs kyi= reg pa'i dug dang*/ dug thams cad phuta cig swā hā/ dug 'dir ma 'dug cig sbyin par byed pa'i gnas su song zhig 'dzin ma'i gan du song zhig me'i nang du song zhig chu nang du song zhig zhi bar gyur cig swā hā zhes brjod/ tshig de 'phags pa dang klu'i rgyal po ba ru ṇas brjod pas/ thams cad de'i bka' las mi 'da' bas bsgrub bya la gnod pa'i bsam pa bskum ste rang rang gi gzugs la zhugs par bsam/ bsgrub bya bkru ba'i chu de nas klu gzugs rnams kyi khar cung zad blug thigs pa re me nang du blugs pas nad thams cad me lha'i zhal du song bar bsam/

bdun pa bsgrub bya seng ge sgrar bskyed la/ thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus de bzhin gshegs pa lnga bkug de dag gis dbang bskur bar bsam te/ shar gyi bum pa blangs nas/ 'di ni me long ye shes chu// nyon mongs zhe sdang sbyong byed cing*// rnam shes phung po rnam dag nas// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku thob shog oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ka la sha abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ 'di ni mnyam nyid/ nga rgyal/ tshor ba'i/ rin chen 'byung gnas/ rat+na ka la sha= trāṃ/ 'di ni sor rtog 'dod chags/ 'du shes/ snang ba mtha' yas/ pad+ma ka la sha= hrīḥ bya grub/ phrag dog 'du byed/ don yod grub pa'i/ karma ka la sha= khaṃ/ dbus kyi bum pa/ chos dbyings ye shes/ gti mug gzugs kyi/ rnam par snang mdzad/ bud+dha ka la sha= bh+ruṃ/ zhes rigs lngas dbang bskur ro// brgyad pa/ rdo rje gnas lngar reg cing*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ha ya grī bā ya/ na mo lo ke shwa rā ya/ oṃ hrīḥtad+ya thā/ ku lu yu lu/ nī la kaṇ+ṭha/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban dha ban dha/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ hā hā hā hā/ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṝ ba hrīḥhūṃ phaṭ/ ces rta mgrin gyi sngags ring gis srungs/ klu dang gdon thams cad kyi yid kyi dug thams cad las srungs shig rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ de bzhin du mthong ba'i/ bcings pa'i/ kha rlangs kyi/ rig pa'i dug thams cad las rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ de nas srung skud btags/ dgu pa/ me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po yis// zhes bkra shis rdzas brgyad sbyin/ gnyis pa ni/ bsnyen gnas la ni gnas gyur nas// dkon mchog rjes dran sems bskyed nas// bum chu dag pas las sgrib sel// lus ngag sems kyi dag pa 'thob// pha rol phyin drug gnas 'gyur zhing*// sangs rgyas sems can mkhyen par 'gyur// ting 'dzin thams cad mngon du 'gyur// bu mo gzhon nus bkal ba yi// skud pa dkar po gsum bsgril la// bzlas brjod nyi shu brgyad byas nas// mgul du btags na nad las dgrol// nad la phan pa'i sman rnams la// gzungs sngags bzlas shing btab gyur na// nad rnams kun las grol bar 'gyur// chu la gzungs sngags mang bzlas na// klu nad khong du sel bar 'gyur// lo tog za ba kha 'chings na// bye ma sa dang thal bas srel// ha cang char pa ches pa na// lha la phul ba'i snying po la// kham phor gsar pa'i nang du yang*// me tog gtsang ma blangs nas ni// bsregs na char pa 'chad par 'gyur// ser ba drag po 'ong ba ni// thal chen yungs kar bzlas brjod kyis// ser ba nya lcibs lcug ma dang*// phon po btags de btsugs gyur na// ser ba 'chad par 'gyur ba yin// bus pa gdon gyis 'jigs pa la// 'gi'u waṃ gis ni srung 'khor bri// yungs kar dag dang bcas te gdags// bus pa gdon dang nad las thar// lam du zhugs te 'gro ba na// thu ba g.yas pa'i gos kyi grwar// bzlas pa bdun byas mdud pa bor// song na bde zhing don yang 'grub// rta la sogs pa'i phyugs rnams la// chu dang yungs kar bcas pa la// bzlas nas gtor na bde bar 'gyur// mi nad phyugs nad thams cad la// yungs kar dang ni bum pa'i chus// bkru zhing btags na mi nad zhi// asma ri yi gzung sel ltar// las rnams thams cad 'grub par 'gyur// zhes so// gzhan du dbang bskur na/

gsol btab/ skyabs sems sbyin/ khrus byas/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ bkra shis kyi rdzas gtad pa rnams yin no// de ltar 'phags pa seng ge'i sgra'i rgyud gzungs ji lta bar bsgrigs pa'i cho ga 'di yang sna phu chos lung pa chos rje ngag dbang 'phrin las rgya mtshos bskul ba'i ngor pad+ma dkar pos sbyar ba yin no/// /maṅgalaṃ///
